title: ServiceNow Developer
description:

Genesis10 is currently seeking a Linux Automation Engineer / Database Infrastructure Engineer for a hybrid position with a Global Financial Institution located in Charlotte, NC. This is a 12+ month contract opportunity.

We are seeking a highly skilled Linux Automation Engineer with strong expertise in infrastructure automation, scripting, and database administration. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience supporting Linux environments, developing automation solutions using Python, Perl, or Shell scripting, and managing enterprise-grade relational database systems such as Oracle and SQL Server. This role will focus on improving operational efficiency, automating system processes, and supporting mission-critical database and infrastructure platforms.

Responsibilities:

  • Administer, maintain, and troubleshoot enterprise Linux environments across development, testing, and production platforms
  • Design, develop, and implement automation solutions using Python, Perl, Shell, or Bash scripting to streamline operational processes and reduce manual effort
  • Build and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions using Terraform for cloud and on-premises infrastructure provisioning
  • Develop automation workflows for system deployment, configuration management, monitoring, patching, and compliance activities
  • Support and optimize Oracle and SQL Server database environments, ensuring performance, availability, and reliability
  • Perform database administration tasks including backup and recovery, performance tuning, capacity planning, and troubleshooting
  • Create and maintain database scripts, stored procedures, and automation routines for operational support
  • Collaborate with application, DevOps, infrastructure, and database teams to implement scalable and resilient solutions
  • Monitor system and database health, proactively identifying and resolving performance bottlenecks
  • Document system architectures, operational procedures, automation frameworks, and database configurations
  • Participate in incident management, root cause analysis, and production support activities

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field
  • 5 years of experience in Linux system administration and infrastructure support
  • Strong experience with Terraform for infrastructure provisioning and configuration management
  • Advanced scripting and automation expertise using Python, Perl, Shell, or Bash
  • Solid understanding of Linux operating systems, system services, networking, and security concepts
  • Strong experience working with relational database management systems (RDBMS), including Oracle and/or Microsoft SQL Server
  • Experience with database performance tuning, SQL query optimization, backup/recovery, and database maintenance
  • Knowledge of version control systems such as Git
  • Experience troubleshooting complex infrastructure and database issues in production environments
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills

Desired skills:

  • Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform
  • Knowledge of CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI/CD
  • Experience with configuration management tools such as Ansible, Puppet, or Chef
  • Familiarity with monitoring and observability tools such as Splunk, Dynatrace, Prometheus, Grafana, or ELK
  • Experience supporting high-availability and disaster recovery environments
  • Oracle DBA and/or Linux administration certifications are a plus
